scenarios.title: Founder liquidity event -- trust-first vs. sell-and-diversify
scenarios.scenario_text: I'm the founder and CEO of Meridian Robotics. An acquirer has agreed to buy the company; my stake is worth about $22M at close, which is expected in the first quarter of 2026. My cost basis is roughly $600K. We're a married California couple, both in our early 50s, two adult kids, net worth around $39M. My estate attorney wants me to move a large block of the founder shares into an irrevocable trust before the deal closes. My financial advisor wants me to sell most of the position and diversify as soon as the cash lands. What should I actually do, and in what order?

stated_goals: keep the after-tax proceeds of the sale as large as possible
reduce estate-tax exposure for the kids
not be forced into a rushed, high-tax sale
